20261122-chemistry-m1-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Xawaaraha faafidda si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-chemistry-m1-1.material: [Xawaaraha faafidda] Dhamaadka labada dhinac ee tuubo muraayad dheer ah waxaa lagu dhex geliyay cudbi lagu qoyay ammonia xooggan (miisaanka molikiyuulka 17) iyo cudbi lagu qoyay hydrochloric acid xooggan (36.5) isla markaas, waxaana lagu xidhay xidhaha rubber-ka ah. Muddo yar kadib, tuubada gudaheeda waxaa soo baxday xariiq qiiq cad ah (ammonium chloride). Xariiqdaas meel ma ku dhow tahay?
20261122-chemistry-m1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Xawaaraha faafidda] Dhamaadka labada dhinac ee tuubo muraayad dheer ah waxaa lagu dhex geliyay cudbi lagu qoyay ammonia xooggan (miisaanka molikiyuulka 17) iyo cudbi lagu qoyay hydrochloric acid xooggan (36.5) isla markaas, waxaana lagu xidhay xidhaha rubber-ka ah. 20261122-chemistry-m1-1.s.s1.explain: Xawaaraha faafidda gaaska waxaa uu ka soo hoos u socdaa xididka labajibbaaran ee miisaanka molikiyuulka. 20261122-chemistry-m2-2.title: Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.topic: Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.material: Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte yar oo la sameeyo electrolysis, kuwee ayaa si sax ah isugu xiraya nooca gaaska laga helo electrode-ka (-) iyo (+) iyo saamiga mugga?
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.thinking.0: Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Marka biyaha lagu dhex daro electrolyte yar oo la sameeyo electrolysis, kuwee ayaa si sax ah isugu xiraya nooca gaaska laga helo electrode-ka (-) iyo (+) iyo saamiga mugga?
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Sida uu isleegga electrolysis-ka biyuhu muujinayo $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, gaaska hydrogen wuxuu ka soo baxaa electrode-ka (-) halka reduction dhacayo, mugga $2$, gaaska oxygen-na wuxuu ka soo baxaa electrode-ka (+) halka oxidation dhacayo, mugga $1$.
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Qaabka kiimikada ee biyuhu waa H₂O (laba atom oo hydrogen ah iyo hal atom oo oxygen ah).
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Electrode (-): hydrogen (H₂),  electrode (+): oxygen (O₂),  saamiga mugga = 2 : 1
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Electrode (-): oxygen (O₂),  electrode (+): hydrogen (H₂),  saamiga mugga = 1 : 2
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Electrode (-): hydrogen (H₂),  electrode (+): chlorine (Cl₂),  saamiga mugga = 1 : 1
20261122-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.o.o3: Electrode (-): uumi biyood,  electrode (+): nitrogen,  saamiga mugga = 2 : 1
